manifest.name: @local/dsh-ui-task-board
manifest.description: Full-screen task board for DeepSeek Harness: every session as a live mini conversation with status, search and inline reply.
manifest.author: Senrian

bundle.text:
# Task board bundle: the Host half is an empty shell; the Client module renders
# the sidebar launcher and the full-screen task grid.
- insert:
    - id: ui-task-board
      name: '@local/dsh-ui-task-board'

readme.text: 一个 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web 客户端插件：把侧边栏那份「一列标题 + 几天前」的会话列表，换成一个全屏任务大屏——每个会话一张卡片，卡片里是这个会话最近几条消息，状态一眼可见，点一下直接进去。

DSH 的会话列表只给你标题和时间，任务一多就完全看不出「哪些在跑、哪些等我拍板、哪些已经完事」。这个插件把这些信息铺开成一张大屏：

- 一屏同时看 4 / 9 / 16 个任务，每个格子都是活的（流式输出实时追加）
- 按状态分组排序：进行中 → 待确定 → 已完成，看得见的永远是当前在处理的
- 卡片上直接回一句话，不用先切会话
- 每张卡片显示所属工作区，跨工作区也不会认错

| 能力 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| 全屏任务大屏 | 左下角「任务大屏」按钮打开，铺满窗口，Esc 或右上角 ✕ 关闭 |
| 每格一个对话窗 | 显示最近 5 条消息（我 / AI / 工具），工具连续同名折叠成 `bash ×3`，流式输出实时追加 |
| 状态分组 | 进行中 / 待确定 / 已完成，自动推断 + 手动覆盖 |
| 排序 | 进行中 → 待确定 → 已完成，同状态内按最近活跃时间倒序 |
| 状态修改 | 每张卡片标题前的下拉，选择记在本地 |
| 搜索 | 按任务标题或工作区名过滤 |
| 状态筛选 | 只看某一类状态 |
| 格子数 | 4 / 9 / 16 三档，等分整屏，选择记在本地 |
| 内联回复 | 卡片底部输入框，回车直接进该会话队列 |
| 工作区标签 | 标题行右侧显示所属工作区 |
| 运行中徽标 | 侧边栏按钮上的绿色数字，显示当前有几个任务在跑 |
| 中英双语 | 跟随 DSH 的界面语言 |

DSH 以 bundle 方式安装本地插件包：

1. 把本仓库克隆或下载到本地，得到包含 `package.json` 的目录
2. 在 DSH 里用插件管理器安装这个目录（`plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，target 传该目录的绝对路径）
3. 安装返回 `application: applied` 后，刷新 Web 页面，左下角会出现「任务大屏」

卸载：在插件管理器里移除 `@local/dsh-ui-task-board` 即可，本插件不改动 DSH 的任何原有文件。

不需要额外配置。以下状态存在浏览器本地（不会写入会话日志，也不影响 Host）：

| localStorage 键 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh.task-board.status.v1` | 会话 id → 状态（`todo` / `doing` / `done`） |
| `dsh.task-board.grid.v1` | 每屏格子数（4 / 9 / 16） |

状态派生规则：没有手动设置过的会话，运行中记为「进行中」，否则记为「待确定」。

- 纯客户端插件：Host 半身是空实现，全部逻辑在 `client.js`（单文件，无构建步骤）
- 注册两个槽位，不覆盖任何已有 UI：
  - `sidebar.footer.action`：启动按钮
  - `shell.overlay`：全屏大屏
- 每个卡片通过 `ctx.sessions.retain(sessionId, { source: 'taskBoard' })` 拿到该会话的最近事件窗口，订阅变化后重新折叠，卸载时释放引用
- 会话列表来自槽位标准 prop `useSessions`；列表接口在超大会话库上可能很慢，此时退回用控制通道已填充的 `byId` 渲染，避免长时间空屏
- 内联回复调用 `binding.session.prompt([{ type: 'text', text }], 'queue')`
- 样式全部使用宿主主题变量（`--dsw-alias-*`、`--dsw-radius-*`），明暗主题自动跟随

```bash
node --check client.js
node tools/render-test.mjs
```

`tools/render-test.mjs` 是一个离线渲染冒烟测试：用假 Host 加载 `client.js`，喂若干合成会话，把大屏渲染成 HTML 后断言卡片数量、排序、格子布局与控件存在性。它不依赖浏览器，可在 CI 里跑。

- 状态只记录在本机浏览器，换机器不同步
- 实时刷新、跳转导航、状态持久化这三条依赖真实运行中的 Web 页面，离线冒烟测试覆盖不到
- 大屏一次性渲染所选格数，大量任务靠底部「再看 N 个」翻页，未做虚拟滚动

A client-side plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) that replaces the sidebar's flat session list with a full-screen task board: one card per session, each card a live mini conversation you can read and reply to without leaving the board.

> 中文说明见 [README.md](README.md).

The default session list gives you a title and a timestamp. With dozens of running tasks you cannot tell which ones are still working, which ones are waiting for you, and which ones are done. This plugin lays those signals out on one screen.

| Feature | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| Full-screen board | Opened from the sidebar footer button, fills the window, closes with Esc or ✕ |
| Live mini conversations | Last 5 messages per session (you / AI / tool), consecutive identical tool calls collapsed to `bash ×3`, streamed output appended in real time |
| Status groups | In progress / To decide / Done, inferred automatically and overridable |
| Sorting | In progress → To decide → Done, then by most recent activity |
| Per-card status | Dropdown in the card header, persisted locally |
| Search | Filters by task title or workspace name |
| Status filter | Show one status group only |
| Grid sizes | 4 / 9 / 16 cells, evenly filling the screen, persisted locally |
| Inline reply | Input at the bottom of each card; Enter queues the message in that session |
| Workspace chip | Shows which workspace the session belongs to |
| Running badge | Green count on the sidebar button |
| i18n | Follows the DSH interface language (en / zh) |

DSH installs client plugins as bundles:

1. Clone or download this repository so you have the directory containing `package.json`
2. In DSH, install that directory through the plugin manager (`plugin_manager` with `install_bundle`, passing the absolute path as `target`)
3. Once installation reports `application: applied`, reload the Web page — a "Task board" button appears at the bottom of the sidebar
Uninstall by removing `@local/dsh-ui-task-board` in the plugin manager. The plugin does not modify any existing DSH file.

None required. Two browser-local keys are used; neither touches the session log or the Host:

| localStorage key | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `dsh.task-board.status.v1` | session id → status (`todo` / `doing` / `done`) |
| `dsh.task-board.grid.v1` | cells per screen (4 / 9 / 16) |

Default status: a session that has never been set manually counts as "In progress" while it runs, otherwise "To decide".

- Client-only plugin: the Host half is an empty `apply()`; all logic lives in `client.js` (single file, no build step)
- Registers two slots and overrides nothing:
  - `sidebar.footer.action` — the launcher button
  - `shell.overlay` — the full-screen board
- Each card calls `ctx.sessions.retain(sessionId, { source: 'taskBoard' })` to read that session's recent event window, re-folds it on every change, and releases the reference on unmount
- The catalog comes from the slot's standard `useSessions` prop. On very large session stores the list RPC can lag, so the board falls back to the `byId` rows already filled by the control channel instead of showing a blank screen
- Inline reply uses `binding.session.prompt([{ type: 'text', text }], 'queue')`
- Styling uses host theme tokens (`--dsw-alias-*`, `--dsw-radius-*`) so light and dark themes follow automatically

```bash
node --check client.js
node tools/render-test.mjs
```

`tools/render-test.mjs` is an offline render smoke test: it loads `client.js` with a fake Host, feeds synthetic sessions, renders the board to HTML, and asserts card count, ordering, grid layout and the presence of the controls. No browser needed, so it runs in CI.

- Status lives in the local browser only; it does not sync across machines
- Live streaming updates, session navigation and status persistence require a running Web page and are not covered by the offline smoke test
- The board renders one screenful of cells at a time; more tasks page in through the "show more" button (no virtual scrolling yet)
